name: Madinet Masr for Housing and Development S.A.E.
source: Madinet Masr FY2025 results investor presentation (issuer, appendix financial statements, EGP thousand, stored absolute)
source_note: Read from the issuer FY2025 results investor presentation appendix balance sheet, EGP thousand stored absolute. The presentation prints the comparative column first (31-Dec-24 then 31-Dec-25); the values here are ordered FY2025 then FY2024 to match the periods array. Identities tie: Non-current Assets 5,373,444.4 + Current Assets 37,926,510.7 = Total Assets 43,299,955.2 for FY2025 (3,083,325.9 + 24,629,891.4 = 27,713,217.2 for FY2024); Non-current Liabilities 3,185,471.7 + Current Liabilities 27,493,916.0 = Total Liabilities 30,679,387.7; Total Liabilities + Total Equity 12,620,567.5 = Total Assets. Cash and Equivalents is the printed Cash on Hand and Banks line, which excludes the separately printed treasury bill holding.
